name: Catto Boi Forever
summary:
Do you have what it takes to restore peace to the island?

Join Catto and friends as you take down the looming threat and retrieve the Titanium Biscuit!

Do it alone, or do it with friends online, through the Forever Network! There are 6 unique game modes you can play in multiplayer!

Your friends in the village need helping out! There are 5 side quests to complete, along with 11 levels in the main campaign. There are also 12 unique levels for some multiplayer game modes!

With the modding API, the possibilities are endless - one could say they go on... FOREVER!
